title: Use trial and sandbox demo environments

facts.text: Prospect trial option lets you add Business Central trial directly to prospect's organization for evaluation.
Prospect trial lasts up to 60 days; if extended once and still uncertain, prospect must contact partner.
Sandbox environments are ideal for demos when you already have a Business Central tenant and want isolated scenarios.
For sandbox demos, you must already have an existing Business Central tenant.
Sandbox environments have limited functionality and performance compared to production environments.
Partners can request dedicated partner sandbox licenses starting February 2022 to set up more sandbox environments.
